entities.name: Sandakan District Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Sandakan District Mosque is a mosque in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia. Built in 1985 and completed in 1989, it is the main mosque for the district of Sandakan. The mosque was officially opened in 1990.
